thread:
riley: Rolling v2.17.0 into eu-west during 09:00-10:30 window. Plan: route-by-route, 5 steps, start at 4%. Keep an eye on embeddings and rerank dashboards.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started · job_id=rl-20260328-77 · step=1 · weights={v2.17.0:4,v2.16.0:96}
noah: embeddings.p95 climbed 140ms -> 410ms at step start, 5xx small bump to 0.3%. Panel: https://console.redwood/slo/embeddings?range=10m
taylor: s/logs look clean, but kv-cache miss rate up. Could be cache priming with new model variant.
slo-bot: [alert] SLO breach: embeddings.p95 > threshold for 3m · recommended=run_short_probe_and_hold
riley: Holding further steps. Run 1% probe against v2.17.0 embeddings and freeze embeddings ramp only. Do not affect rerank/text-gen.
deploy-bot: [automated] action=hold_rollout · job_id=rl-20260328-77 · affected=embeddings
noah: Probe results: tail still ~420ms, traces point at attention kernel hotspot. Trace: https://traces.redwood/rl-77/probe
taylor: Given this, suggest route-only rollback for embeddings to last-known-good v2.16.0. Prepare weight change and audit note.
riley: Apply it now and log audit.
taylor: curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/route-weight -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"embeddings","weights":{"v2.17.0":0,"v2.16.0":100}}'  # applied
deploy-bot: [automated] weights_updated · route=embeddings · from={v2.17.0:4} -> to={v2.16.0:100} · job_id=rl-20260328-77-weights
noah: SLOs recovering: p95 down to 160ms, 5xx to 0.08% within 90s :thumbsup:
riley: Updating release notes: "v2.17.0 embeddings paused due to p95 regression; embeddings routed to v2.16.0. Follow-up: ENG-5340 runtime perf triage." Keep rerank ramping.
slo-bot: [summary] partial_rollback_complete · affected_route=embeddings · followup=ENG-5340
